$comment: P127 B8 (section 14). Generated C# shapes no other SDK-compiled parity fixture declares: an arity pair (Box and Box<T>, IShape and IShape<T>), a comparer slot, the non-generic IEqualityComparer and IComparer bridges on comparer subclasses, a generic class's static listener, an abstract object-member override, a shift whose count isn't int (left out of C#), `out` results a flow attribute or a nullable type lets stay null, explicit IEquatable<C> and IComparable<C> implementations (with their read-only bridges), protected and private getters, a derived class's own construction of an interface its base already implements (IComparable, IEquatable and a user interface, each called through both constructions, and a generic GD<T> : G<T> re-implementing IComparable<GD<T>> and IX<GD<T>> explicitly over a public base and publicly over an explicit base, and ReB : ReA, IComparable<ReA> re-implementing its base's own construction explicitly, ReBE the same for IEquatable<ReAE> and ReBX publicly over an explicit base, each called through both constructions and the Default comparers), and Reference<T> under a system-interface constraint bound to int (a slot) and to a class (a handle). The rest of the source repeats shapes other fixtures cover so the shapes test pins them in one place. Each case calls a static Probe function of `source` on a fresh session; `returns` pins its result, which matches .NET 10. The web half runs through `neo test` and pins the generated C# (cli/src/commands/p127-codegen-shapes.test.ts); the Unity half runs the same cases over a `neo export`, and makes each `csharpBridges` call from C# on the generated receiver cast to `interface` (or, for an `interface` ending in `.Default`, on that comparer); it must return the `returns` of the probe with the same name. Vendor this file verbatim.
source: class Box { public int A = 1; }
class Box<T> { public T? V; public static int Count = 0; public static NeoAction Changed; }
interface IShape { int Sides(); }
interface IShape<T> { T Size(); }
class Sq : IShape, IShape<int> { public int Sides() => 4; public int Size() => 2; }
class Coin : IEquatable<Coin> {
public int V = 0;
public bool Equals(Coin? other) => other != null && other.V == V;
public override bool Equals(object? obj) => obj is Coin c && Equals(c);
public override int GetHashCode() => V;
public override string ToString() => "coin";
abstract class Keyed { public abstract override int GetHashCode(); }
class KeyedN : Keyed { public override int GetHashCode() => 2; }
interface IKeyedBy<T> : IEquatable<T> { int Key(); }
class ById : IKeyedBy<ById> { public int Key() => 1; public bool Equals(ById? other) => other != null && other.Key() == Key(); }
class Ci : EqualityComparer<string> { public override bool Equals(string? x, string? y) => x == y; public override int GetHashCode(string obj) => 0; }
class Fold : EqualityComparer<string> { public override bool Equals(string? x, string? y) => x?.ToLower() == y?.ToLower(); public override int GetHashCode(string obj) => obj.Length; }
class ByLen : Comparer<string> { public override int Compare(string? x, string? y) => (x ?? "").Length - (y ?? "").Length; }
class Pt {
public int X = 0;
public static Pt operator +(Pt a, Pt b) { var p = new Pt(); p.X = a.X + b.X; return p; }
public static Pt operator <<(Pt a, Pt b) => a;
interface IV<out T> { string Name() => "v"; }
class Kv : IV<string> { }
class InitOnly { public int A { get; init; } = 0; }
class Auto { public int W { get; protected set; } = 1; }
class Holder { public CultureInfo Culture = CultureInfo.InvariantCulture; public IFormatProvider? Provider = null; public EqualityComparer<string>? Cmp = null; }
class ExplicitEq : IEquatable<ExplicitEq> { public int K = 0; public ExplicitEq(int k) { K = k; } bool IEquatable<ExplicitEq>.Equals(ExplicitEq? other) => other != null && other.K == K; }
class ExplicitCmp : IComparable<ExplicitCmp> { public int K = 0; public ExplicitCmp(int k) { K = k; } int IComparable<ExplicitCmp>.CompareTo(ExplicitCmp? other) => other == null ? 1 : K - other.K; }
class Gated { public int P { protected get; set; } = 0; public int Q { private get; set; } = 0; public int Sum() => P * 10 + Q; }
class GatedSub : Gated { public int ReadP() => P; }
class Money : IComparable<Money> { public int V = 0; public int CompareTo(Money? other) => other == null ? 1 : V - other.V; }
class BaseC : IComparable<BaseC> { public int K = 1; public int CompareTo(BaseC? other) => other == null ? -1 : 10 + other.K; }
class DerC : BaseC, IComparable<DerC> { int IComparable<DerC>.CompareTo(DerC? other) => other == null ? -1 : 40 + other.K; }
class BaseE : IEquatable<BaseE> { public bool Equals(BaseE? other) => other != null; }
class DerE : BaseE, IEquatable<DerE> { bool IEquatable<DerE>.Equals(DerE? other) => false; }
interface IMeasure<T> { int Measure(T other); }
class BaseM : IMeasure<BaseM> { public int Measure(BaseM other) => 1; }
class DerM : BaseM, IMeasure<DerM> { int IMeasure<DerM>.Measure(DerM other) => 2; }
class ReA : IComparable<ReA> { public int CompareTo(ReA? o) => 1; }
class ReB : ReA, IComparable<ReA> { int IComparable<ReA>.CompareTo(ReA? o) => 9; }
class ReAE : IEquatable<ReAE> { public bool Equals(ReAE? o) => true; }
class ReBE : ReAE, IEquatable<ReAE> { bool IEquatable<ReAE>.Equals(ReAE? o) => false; }
class ReAX : IComparable<ReAX> { int IComparable<ReAX>.CompareTo(ReAX? o) => 1; }
class ReBX : ReAX, IComparable<ReAX> { public int CompareTo(ReAX? o) => 9; }
interface IX<T> { int X(T o); }
class GE<T> : IComparable<GE<T>>, IX<GE<T>> { public int CompareTo(GE<T>? o) => 0; public int X(GE<T> o) => 0; }
class GDE<T> : GE<T>, IComparable<GDE<T>>, IX<GDE<T>> { int IComparable<GDE<T>>.CompareTo(GDE<T>? o) => 5; int IX<GDE<T>>.X(GDE<T> o) => 6; }
class GP<T> : IComparable<GP<T>>, IX<GP<T>> { int IComparable<GP<T>>.CompareTo(GP<T>? o) => 0; int IX<GP<T>>.X(GP<T> o) => 0; }
class GDP<T> : GP<T>, IComparable<GDP<T>>, IX<GDP<T>> { public int CompareTo(GDP<T>? o) => 5; public int X(GDP<T> o) => 6; }
class Slot<T extends IComparable<T>> { public T Value; public Reference<T> R; public Slot(T value) { this.Value = value; this.R = Reference(this.Value); } }
class Parsed {
public int V = 0;
public static bool TryParse(string s, @maybeNullWhen(false) out Parsed result) { if (s == "ok") { result = new Parsed(); result.V = 1; return true; } result = default; return false; }
public static bool TryFind(string s, @notNullWhen(true) out Parsed? result) { result = s == "ok" ? new Parsed() : null; return result != null; }
public static bool TryFirst<T>(List<T> items, @maybeNullWhen(false) out T result) { if (items.Count > 0) { result = items[0]; return true; } result = default; return false; }
class Probe {
@storage(allowed: .Session) public static Slot<int>? StoredInt;
@storage(allowed: .Session) public static Slot<Money>? StoredMoney;
public static ExplicitEq EqLeft = new ExplicitEq(4);
public static ExplicitEq EqRight = new ExplicitEq(4);
public static ExplicitCmp CmpLeft = new ExplicitCmp(5);
public static ExplicitCmp CmpRight = new ExplicitCmp(2);
public static DerC DerLeft = new DerC();
public static DerC DerRight = new DerC();
public static DerE DerEqLeft = new DerE();
public static DerE DerEqRight = new DerE();
public static DerM MeasureLeft = new DerM();
public static DerM MeasureRight = new DerM();
public static GDE<int> GenericExplicitLeft = new GDE<int>();
public static GDE<int> GenericExplicitRight = new GDE<int>();
public static GDP<int> GenericPublicLeft = new GDP<int>();
public static GDP<int> GenericPublicRight = new GDP<int>();
public static ReB RelistedLeft = new ReB();
public static ReA RelistedRight = new ReA();
public static ReBE RelistedEqLeft = new ReBE();
public static ReAE RelistedEqRight = new ReAE();
public static ReBX RelistedPublicLeft = new ReBX();
public static ReAX RelistedPublicRight = new ReAX();
public static Fold FoldComparer = new Fold();
public static ByLen LengthComparer = new ByLen();
public static bool TryIt(out int v) { v = 1; return true; }
public static int OutArgument() { if (TryIt(out var v)) return v; return -1; }
public static int ArityPair() { var b = new Box(); var g = new Box<string>(); g.V = "seven"; return b.A * 10 + (g.V ?? "").Length; }
public static int InterfaceArityPair() { IShape s = new Sq(); IShape<int> t = new Sq(); return s.Sides() * 10 + t.Size(); }
public static int GenericStaticPerConstruction() { Box<int>.Count = 3; Box<string>.Count = 5; return Box<int>.Count * 10 + Box<string>.Count; }
public static string OverrideToString() { object o = new Coin(); return o.ToString(); }
public static bool OverrideEquals() { var a = new Coin(); a.V = 2; var b = new Coin(); b.V = 2; object o = a; return o.Equals(b); }
public static int OverrideGetHashCode() { var c = new Coin(); c.V = 9; object o = c; return o.GetHashCode(); }
public static int OperatorForward() { var a = new Pt(); a.X = 1; var b = new Pt(); b.X = 2; return (a + b).X; }
public static bool ComparerSlot() { var h = new Holder(); h.Cmp = new Ci(); return h.Cmp.Equals("a", "a") && h.Cmp.GetHashCode("x") == 0; }
public static string DefaultInterfaceMember() { IV<string> v = new Kv(); return v.Name(); }
public static bool NonGenericComparerEquals() { IEqualityComparer c = FoldComparer; return c.Equals("lower", "LOWER"); }
public static int NonGenericComparerGetHashCode() { IEqualityComparer c = FoldComparer; return c.GetHashCode("abc"); }
public static int NonGenericComparerCompare() { IComparer c = LengthComparer; return c.Compare("aa", "b"); }
public static bool MaybeNullOutFails() { return !Parsed.TryParse("bad", out var p) && p == null; }
public static int MaybeNullOutSucceeds() { if (Parsed.TryParse("ok", out var p)) return p.V; return -1; }
public static bool NotNullOutFails() { return !Parsed.TryFind("bad", out var p) && p == null; }
public static bool GenericMaybeNullOutFails() { return !Parsed.TryFirst(new List<string>(), out var s) && s == null; }
public static int AbstractOverrideHash() { object o = new KeyedN(); return o.GetHashCode(); }
public static bool InheritedEquatable() { IKeyedBy<ById> k = new ById(); return k.Equals(new ById()); }
public static bool ExplicitEquatable() { IEquatable<ExplicitEq> e = EqLeft; return e.Equals(EqRight); }
public static int ExplicitComparable() { IComparable<ExplicitCmp> c = CmpLeft; return c.CompareTo(CmpRight); }
public static int DerivedComparable() { IComparable<DerC> c = DerLeft; return c.CompareTo(DerRight); }
public static int DerivedBaseComparable() { IComparable<BaseC> c = DerLeft; return c.CompareTo(DerRight); }
public static bool DerivedEquatable() { IEquatable<DerE> e = DerEqLeft; return e.Equals(DerEqRight); }
public static bool DerivedBaseEquatable() { IEquatable<BaseE> e = DerEqLeft; return e.Equals(DerEqRight); }
public static int DerivedInterface() { IMeasure<DerM> m = MeasureLeft; return m.Measure(MeasureRight); }
public static int ExplicitGenericCmp() { IComparable<GDE<int>> a = new GDE<int>(); return a.CompareTo(new GDE<int>()); }
public static int ExplicitGenericX() { IX<GDE<int>> b = new GDE<int>(); return b.X(new GDE<int>()); }
public static int ExplicitGenericBase() { IComparable<GE<int>> g = new GDE<int>(); return g.CompareTo(new GE<int>()); }
public static int PublicGenericCmp() { IComparable<GDP<int>> a = new GDP<int>(); return a.CompareTo(new GDP<int>()); }
public static int PublicGenericX() { IX<GDP<int>> b = new GDP<int>(); return b.X(new GDP<int>()); }
public static int PublicGenericBase() { IComparable<GP<int>> g = new GDP<int>(); return g.CompareTo(new GP<int>()); }
public static int RelistedComparable() { IComparable<ReA> c = RelistedLeft; return c.CompareTo(RelistedRight); }
public static int RelistedComparer() => Comparer<ReA>.Default.Compare(RelistedLeft, RelistedRight);
public static int RelistedPublicMember() => RelistedLeft.CompareTo(RelistedRight);
public static bool RelistedEquatable() { IEquatable<ReAE> e = RelistedEqLeft; return e.Equals(RelistedEqRight); }
public static bool RelistedEqualityComparer() => EqualityComparer<ReAE>.Default.Equals(RelistedEqLeft, RelistedEqRight);
public static int RelistedPublic() { IComparable<ReAX> c = RelistedPublicLeft; return c.CompareTo(RelistedPublicRight); }
public static int RelistedPublicComparer() => Comparer<ReAX>.Default.Compare(RelistedPublicLeft, RelistedPublicRight);
public static int DerivedBaseInterface() { IMeasure<BaseM> m = MeasureLeft; return m.Measure(MeasureRight); }
public static int ProtectedAndPrivateGetters() { var g = new GatedSub(); g.P = 2; g.Q = 3; return g.Sum() * 10 + g.ReadP(); }
public static int ReferenceIntWrite() { var s = new Slot<int>(3); s.R = 9; return s.Value; }
public static int ReferenceIntRead() { var s = new Slot<int>(4); return s.R; }
public static int ReferenceClassWrite() { var m = new Money(); m.V = 5; var s = new Slot<Money>(m); s.R.V = 8; return s.Value.V; }
public static bool ReferenceClassSame() { var m = new Money(); var s = new Slot<Money>(m); return object.ReferenceEquals(s.R, s.Value); }
public static int ReferenceStoredInt() { StoredInt = new Slot<int>(6); StoredInt.R = 11; return StoredInt.Value; }
public static int ReferenceStoredClass() { var m = new Money(); m.V = 2; StoredMoney = new Slot<Money>(m); StoredMoney.R.V = 12; return StoredMoney.Value.V; }
